{
  "description": "L7 is a large-scale WebGL-powered geospatial data visualization engine for rendering map layers (points, lines, polygons, heatmaps) on top of base maps like Mapbox or AMap. It provides client-side rendering capabilities but does not include server-side logic for state management, route computation, geofencing, or position history storage.",

    "Adaptation involves building a separate backend service for state, geofencing, and history; L7 is used only as the rendering frontend library.",

  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No server-side capabilities (state management, geofencing, route computation, history storage)",
    "No MQTT or WebSocket server implementation",

    "L7 is a frontend visualization library, not a backend service; using it as a 'Map Visualization Service' backend is architecturally incorrect.",
